question: How many titles did West Bengal win in the Santosh Trophy events up to the 2022-23 season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3 (32)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• West Bengal has won the prestigious **Santosh Trophy** a record **32 times** up to the 2022-23 season.
 
• The state has been a dominant force in Indian football, with its first title victory dating back to **1941**.
 
• West Bengal's most recent triumph in the Santosh Trophy came in the **2016-17 season**, defeating Goa 1-0 in the final.
 
• West Bengal has consistently showcased its footballing prowess by producing numerous talented players who have represented India at various levels.
 
• The Santosh Trophy is considered one of the most prestigious football tournaments for state and institutional teams in India, organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santosh Trophy Overview:**

 
 
• Established in **1941**, it is an annual football competition in India.
 
• The tournament is named after **Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh**, who was the President of the Indian Football Association (IFA).
 
 
 
• **Format of the Tournament:**
 
 
• Teams from Indian states, union territories, and government institutions participate in the competition.
 
• The format includes group stages followed by knockout rounds, culminating in the final.
 
 
 
• **All India Football Federation (AIFF):**
 
 
• It is the governing body for football in India, established in **1937**.
 
• The AIFF oversees the organization of major football tournaments in the country, including the Santosh Trophy.
 
 
 
• **Other Key Performers:**
 
 
• Kerala and Punjab are other top-performing teams in the Santosh Trophy, each with multiple titles.
 
• Kerala has won the tournament **6 times**, while Punjab has secured victory **8 times**.
